# Dailies

> Dailies is a motivational quotes app. It sends short motivational quotes through the day, from the topics you follow and in the hours you choose, and keeps a fresh one on your Lock Screen and Home Screen widget, so you get your daily motivation without opening the app. It is on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

Key facts:

- What it does: quotes arrive as notifications at varied times inside the hours you set, and a widget on the Lock Screen and Home Screen always shows a fresh one. There is also a feed to swipe through when you want more.
- Topics: you follow the topics you care about (calm, confidence, humor, work, health, faith, creativity and more) and Dailies picks from those. Change them, how often quotes arrive and the hours you can be reached at any time.
- Your own quotes: heart quotes to keep them under Liked quotes, and write your own lines under My quotes. Both are backed up to your iCloud account.
- Styling: backgrounds, typefaces and effects behind each quote, including quiet moving effects on the widget, and your own photos and colors with Premium.
- Price: free to download, with a free set of topics, backgrounds and typefaces. Dailies Premium is an optional subscription that opens every topic, background, typeface and effect.
- No account needed to start.
- Languages: English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
- Devices: iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape.
- Made by one person, Amit Shabtay, with editorial rules for which quotes get in (see About).
- Download: [Dailies - Daily Motivation on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6804210416?pt=129347926&ct=web-llms&mt=8)
